sentences.text: The prayer made in the instant petition is for a direction to the Special Land Acquisition Officer (Joint Organization), District Varanasi (respondent no.2) to decide the application of the petitioners dated 26.07.2023 and reminder dated 28.10.2023 filed in pursuance of the order of Arbitral Tribunal dated 01.06.2023.

sentences.text: The Arbitral Tribunal, by order dated 01.06.2023, has allowed the application filed by the petitioners under Section 20-F(6) of the Railways Act and has remanded the matter back to the Competent Authority for taking a fresh decision in relation to determination of the compensation amount.

The petitioners had filed application and reminder so as to enable the Special Land Acquisition Officer to determine the claim of the petitioner for compensation in compliance of the order of the Arbitrator dated 01.06.2023, however, the same has not been decided so far.
4. Counsel for the respondents have no objection in case the prayer made in the petition is granted.

5. Accordingly, the petition is disposed of with a direction to the Competent Authority to decide the claim of the petitioners for compensation in pursuance of the order of the Arbitrator dated 01.06.2023 within three months from the date of communication of the instant order.
